description: This file provides a temporary debug helper function to list objects within a Supabase Storage bucket, primarily for verification purposes during development or debugging. It includes environment-based gating to prevent accidental usage in production.

methods.name: debugListBucket(bucket, prefix = undefined)
methods.description: Asynchronously lists files in a specified Supabase Storage bucket, optionally filtered by a prefix. The function only executes if debugging is enabled via environment variables.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Optional prefix/path to list within the bucket.
